_doc: Skills the sim runs (js/sim/skills.js). M4 has the Wanderer's three; M9 adds the Paths, M20+ the specs. Fields: owner (wanderer|fighter|rogue|mage|healer|<spec>), kind (melee: weapon hit at weapon range | bolt: a projectile at `range` | heal | self), target (enemy|ally|self), cast (seconds, 0 = instant; moving cancels a cast), cd (seconds, besides the 1.5 s global cooldown unless gcd:false), cost ({mana|rage|energy: n}), range (metres), weaponMult (melee/ranged: x weapon damage), base ([a, b] = a + b x level, for spells and heals, x spell/heal power), type (damage type), threat (multiplier), interrupts (true = stops a cast it lands on), desc (player text).

attack.name: Attack
attack.desc: Swing at your target whenever your weapon is ready. Starts by itself when you use a weapon skill.

sure_strike.name: Sure Strike
sure_strike.desc: A careful blow for 145% of your weapon's damage.

spark.name: Spark
spark.desc: Throw a crackling spark that deals storm damage. Takes a moment to cast.

field_mend.name: Field Mend
field_mend.desc: Bind your own or a friend's wounds. Heals over the cast; works on yourself if nobody is picked.

shove.name: Shove
shove.desc: Knock your target off balance, stopping whatever it is casting. Does not use the global cooldown.
